verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Basecamp exposing its data to external AI agents through MCP support, a CLI, and skills, and letting users invite AI agents into projects. Nothing documents native, in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data. Connecting outside agents is adjacent integration plumbing, not the in-product insight capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
